lines.en: : AAAAAAAHH!
: HAH...HHHHAH........AH...
: Hah...hah.....
: Ngh...
: Hah...
The plan was a failure.
Not only was I alone when I opened my eyes, but I wasn’t even in the place they likely closed in.
As such, I’m here again.
It was easy this time.
I understood everything that was happening the whole way here.
And I understand everything now that I’ve arrived.
The world is going to end.
But I am going to be okay.
Because there are still things that I have to do.
And there is still something out there that wants to keep me alive.
I understand that now.
God is real.
He’s just abandoned us.
: Oh my God...
: Sensei...
: Sensei!
: Who’s ready for a field trip back to roughly two months into the school year?
: Do you have any idea how long you’ve been gone?! I was worried sick!
: I thought I’d never see you again! Where were you? Where did you go?! Why did you leave?!
: Was she like this when you couldn’t find me as well?
: Not even close.
: So it’s just you she’ll break down for. Got it.
: How are you so calm?! You’ve been like this the whole time! I don’t get it! You love him too, don’t you?! Why aren’t you showing it?!
: I’m calm because I’ve been through this more times than you could even imagine. One week is nothing.
: A week? You two have been here for an entire week?
: Yes. And kudos to Ayane for not breaking down until the fourth day. She was actually rather stable and mostly bearable beforehand.
: I’m sorry to hear that. I obviously didn’t mean to keep you waiting that long.
: Just be happy the world hasn’t reset without you. Apart from that, I have some good news and bad news.
: The bad news is, unfortunately, it appears that both of our new companions have been left behind. Of course, that can not be said definitively given what happened last time, but still.
: It’s probably safe to assume they won’t be joining us.
: The good news is that we did manage to learn that it is possible for others to learn of the loops without any immediately negative consequences.
: We still don’t know just what prerequisites are required to get the others to a point like that, but we know now that it is possible. Progress has been made and a celebration is in order.
: Or...will be in order. I didn’t exactly pack a picnic this time and, even if I had, I’m sure none of the food would still be very edible.
: It’s really you...right? You’re not some memory-wiped replacement of Sensei that Maya conjured up to get me to stop crying?
: Just who exactly do you think I am?
: Someone who has not made the last week very easy for me, that’s for sure.
: Get a grip. If you really are going to become a regular member of our rooftop get-togethers, you’re going to have to get accustomed to...prolonged leaves of apocalyptic absence from time to time.
: Of course, there’s no guarantee you’ll still be here once the world resets anyway, but I digress.
: Still holding onto your pregnancy theory even though Ayane made it here again despite an entire cycle of abstinence?
: It’s not as if I surveyed you the entire time. You very well could have gone behind my back and created a secret child. I know exactly how insatiable the two of you are.
: But assuming I do believe you, I’ll be holding onto my theory until the sun comes back up.
: Which could very well be any minute now that Sensei is-
: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
: You need to learn to be more sensitive with other people’s feelings.
: If I haven’t learned that trait by now, it’s probably safe to assume I’m either never going to, or...have just neglected to really hone it.
: I...am going to have...so much sex next cycle. Just to spite you.
: I can’t help but be a little offended by that. I don’t think I’ve ever been used for revenge sex before.
: Sensei...I’m so glad you’re back. This was somehow even worse than the first time I couldn’t find you — and that’s in no small part to understanding just what’s at stake now.
: Next time the world is about to end, instead of a slumber party, I’m just going to tie myself to you. That way, you won’t be able to get away and I won’t lose my very last bit of sanity.
: Can you tell her to stop rambling on about the next cycle when we still don’t technically know if-
: Knock it off, Maya. There’s no harm in letting her be a little hopeful.
: If she’s going to have to get accustomed to “prolonged leaves of apocalyptic absence,” you’re going to have to get used to being wrong sometimes.
: You don’t know everything anymore. You’re in the same exact boat as us. So stop trying to sound all knowledgeable and just figure shit out along the way like a real human.
: Wow.
: We almost kiss one time and now you think it’s okay to talk to me like I am inferior to you. Real nice.
: What part of the “same boat” do you not get? You’re not inferior. You’re on the same level as us.
: I don’t think you understand how boats work. Boats have captains...crewmen...other...boat-people. They’re not all on the same level just because they’re on a single seafaring vessel.
: Well, everyone on this boat is on the same level. End of discussion.
: I have a boat. I just can’t really get to it anymore on account of the wall.
: I said “end of discussion.” That means you too, Ayane.
: Got it.
: I like the side of you that puts Maya in her place. Any time I try to do that, she just makes me feel really bad about myself.
: I have not been put in place. I just see no point in continuing to argue about a topic as stupid as boats when the world is about to end.
: It’s really weird that we’ve gotten to a point where sentences like that aren’t all that strange.
: Yeah...
: It really is.
: Aww...damn it.
: How am I supposed to stay mad at you when you look like that?
: This calls for a group hug! We can celebrate with that instead of a picnic.
: Oh? Are you already forgetting that something like that is exactly how we get out of this mess?
: Of course not. It just feels a little less formal if we’re doing it because we love one another and not because God likes watching people hug or something.
: I couldn’t have said it better myself.
: You definitely could have. That wasn’t my greatest line.
: You said it, not me.
: Alright! Bring it in, everybody! Time for another field trip through time!
: Wait, before we go back...there’s something I want to say.
: Is it that you actually love me and that you’re only mean all the time because you’re putting on a brave face?
: No. It’s that if I am right and not having a child inside of you while doing this wipes your slate clean of all these memories, you are going to owe me dinner.
: How will I even know that if I don’t have any memories of this?
: I’ll figure that out later.
: Can I say something as well?
: No.
: Go ahead, Sensei. I’ll listen to you.
: I’m glad it’s you two I get to do this with.
: Anyone else would just feel...wrong.
: Probably because it would be wrong.
: Me next! Me next!
: When the world resets...
: And we all make it back...
: I don’t care where we end up...
: But wherever it is...
: Know that I am going to tackle Sensei and proceed to make passionate love to him regardless of whether or not Maya is there.
: Kay. Done. Send us home, Maya.
: After that? I’m not sure if I want-
: I’m assuming you...still have all of your memories?
: Mhm.
: I see.
: Maya?
: Yes?
: You might want to look away.
: Wait, you were actually serious?!
: Excuse me...teacher? I have a problem I need some help with.
: Uhh...
: Hold on...you realize we’re still at school, right? Someone could come up here any-
: Don’t care. Infinite world. Modifiable memory. Ayane do sex now.
: Maybe...it would be best if we waited until-
: Amamiya hidden technique — glomp of the midnight sun!
: Please don’t-
: Ayane, what the fuck?!
: What do you think you’re doing?!
: Something I should have done a long time ago.
: Like, literally. I stopped having sex for an entire school year for no reason. I must now make up for lost time.
: How insatiable are you?! Couldn’t you have at least waited until I was gone?!
Ayane climbs on top of me and I am suddenly in a rather...uhh...well, you can see what type of situation it is.
: Did you miss me? Because I missed you. And I am about to ride you so hard that your penis might break off. Sorry in advance.
: At least give Maya a chance to-
: Maya’s not going to leave now that she knows what’s going on. She’s going to stay here and yell and try to make us feel bad.
: Let her watch. I don’t even care.
: Yeah! You’re making that extremely apparent!
: Ayane...come on.
: Oh, I will. I’m so fucking horny right now that I’ll probably cum the second it’s inside.
She pulls her waist back and forth, slowly grinding against my dick- which is, as you may have guessed, extremely hard.
: Then...I’ll cum again.
: And again.
: And again...and again...and again...
: And we can keep doing that for the next several months or so until everybody disappears and I have finally had my fill.
She presses her body harder against mine...
: Seriously, stop! You’re being fucking...gross!
: Ayane...
: Yeah, [ayanemaster]?
: Let’s...
: Let’s do this later, okay?
: What?! Seriously?! But we’ve already waited so long!
: Which is why a couple more hours shouldn’t be that much of a problem.
: Tch!
: If you’d have just looked away like I asked, there would be a penis inside of me right now! I can barely even remember what that feels like, Maya!
: Uhh...I’m...I’m sorry?
Ayane pulls herself off of me and I have to awkwardly adjust myself so the following conversation doesn’t take place with an extremely large protrusion bulging out of my pants...
: Hmph!
: Do you not have the decency to fix yourself? You’re just going to stand here looking like that?
: I want Sensei to see what he’s missing.
: As if he hasn’t already memorized it...
: I’m sorry, Ayane. It’s just-
: I know exactly what it is. But that doesn’t mean I’m not going to be grumpy about it when I have been looking forward to this day for far longer than any girl should ever have to.
: Oh, cry me a river.
: Sensei, you are to report directly to me the moment school is over. From that point on, I can not guarantee your safety.
: Water and other refreshments will be provided, and a change of clothes will likely be necessary. Perhaps multiple.
: I am going to go make preparations and leave you here. But please know that if you have sex with Maya before me and this was all a coordinated effort on both of your behalves to shoo me away-
: I’m gonna be really mad!
: That’s it? That’s your threat?
: And I mean it!
: Hah...
: Thanks, Ayane. I really appreciate it and will report to you as soon as possible.
: You’re darn right you will!
Ayane storms off, leaving me alone in the midst of an extremely awkward silence with someone who I may have just saved from permanent visual impairment and emotional trauma.
: Ugh. I was really banking on that pregnancy theory. Now I have to deal with this for the rest of forever. Wonderful.
: Was only a matter of time until you had to face the music. I don’t think any less of you for not being an expert on a concept no mortal would ever be able to grasp.
: I suppose that’s true.
: And...um...
: Thank you...for stopping her.
: I didn’t believe she was actually going to go through with it. I’m used to people having a bit more...tact.
: Are you? Because you spend a lot of time with me and that’s sure as hell not a quality I’m known for.
: No, you’re certainly not. And it’s honestly a miracle that I’ve been able to deal with you for even half as long as I have.
: The same could be said for you. There aren’t many people who can face such constant beratement and still wind up coming back for more.
: You’re right. It would take either a monster or the world’s most insidious pervert to waltz into such torment. Unsurprisingly, you are both of those things. I hope you’re proud of yourself.
: I get by. Having someone constantly reminding me of how horrible I am has actually done wonders in desensitizing me to my own wrongdoings. So thank you for that.
: You’re welcome. I hope you die.
: Likewise.
: I was worried too...
: I know.
: Never disappear for that long again. I mean it.
: It would have been fine for you to break down too, you know? You didn’t have to stay strong the whole time.
: I got all of my crying out of the way on Christmas.
: I’ll be fine for a thousand more years.
The day ends.
But something else begins.
